Bayside Salon & Spa is a spacious, beautifully designed retreat just off Highway DVP. As your one-stop beauty destination, we bring together expert hair, nails, head spa, and more under one roof. A place where relaxation meets style, we’re here to help you refresh, unwind, and leave feeling your absolute best in the heart of Toronto.

What sets Bayside Salon and Spa apart is the care stylists take to understand each client’s preferences, pairing thoughtful consultations with precise haircuts and colour. Clients also appreciate the attentive service and relaxing head massage during a wash, with each visit leaving them feeling listened to and pleased with their finished style.
